sql:
SELECT d.account_id 
FROM disp d 
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id 
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' 
AND l.status = 'approved' 
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT account_id 
    FROM account 
    WHERE account_id = d.account_id 
    AND frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNY'
)
AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(amount) 
    FROM loan 
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' 
    AND status = 'approved'
)
